description: Work with your Lexware Office (formerly lexoffice) accounting: create and update contacts and articles, write invoices, quotations, order confirmations and delivery notes, search every voucher, and manage webhooks.

lexware_office_invoice_overdue_trigger.description: Runs when an invoice in Lexware Office passes its due date without being paid, such as to send a reminder. Runs once per invoice. Invoices already overdue when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.due_date: When payment is due, YYYY-MM-DD, if it has a due date.
output.invoice_id: The invoice's ID, for Get invoice.
output.link: A link to open the invoice in Lexware Office.
output.open_amount: What is still owed, a plain number.
output.status: Its status, such as open, overdue, paid or accepted.
output.total_amount: The total, with taxes, a plain number such as 119.00.
output.voucher_number: The invoice number, such as RE1012.

lexware_office_invoice_paid_trigger.description: Runs when an invoice in Lexware Office is marked paid in full, such as to thank the customer. Runs once per invoice. Invoices already paid when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.due_date: When payment is due, YYYY-MM-DD, if it has a due date.
output.invoice_id: The invoice's ID, for Get invoice.
output.link: A link to open the invoice in Lexware Office.
output.open_amount: What is still owed, a plain number.
output.status: Its status, such as open, overdue, paid or accepted.
output.total_amount: The total, with taxes, a plain number such as 119.00.
output.voucher_number: The invoice number, such as RE1012.

lexware_office_new_invoice_trigger.description: Runs when an invoice in Lexware Office is finalized and gets its number, with the customer, total and due date. Drafts don't start it until they are finalized, nor do invoices already there when the workflow is turned on. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.due_date: When payment is due, YYYY-MM-DD, if it has a due date.
output.invoice_id: The invoice's ID, for Get invoice.
output.link: A link to open the invoice in Lexware Office.
output.open_amount: What is still owed, a plain number.
output.status: Its status, such as open, overdue, paid or accepted.
output.total_amount: The total, with taxes, a plain number such as 119.00.
output.voucher_number: The invoice number, such as RE1012.

lexware_office_quotation_accepted_trigge.description: Runs when a quotation in Lexware Office is marked accepted, such as to turn it into an order or invoice. Runs once per quotation. Quotations already accepted when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.due_date: When payment is due, YYYY-MM-DD, if it has a due date.
output.link: A link to open the quotation in Lexware Office.
output.open_amount: What is still owed, a plain number.
output.quotation_id: The quotation's ID, for Get quotation.
output.status: Its status, such as open, overdue, paid or accepted.
output.total_amount: The total, with taxes, a plain number such as 119.00.
output.voucher_number: The quotation number, such as RE1012.
